verses.text: Oxe' ab'il malaj jab'ok owal t'a skal chonhab' Israel yet' heb' sirio.
Haxo ix el yoxil ab'il chi', ix k'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá lolonel yet' winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi'.

Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet'ok: --Ha hex tik heyojtak sik'lab'il to ha chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, kiktaxon yaji. ¿Tas yuj max kik'ek' t'a winh sreyal Siria chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mamax yal ha k'o'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha hin tik ol hin b'at het'ok yet' masanil heb' hin soldado yet' jantak nok' hin chej yik owal.
Palta ayik manto och owal chi', ol ko k'anb'ej t'a Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yawtankot 400 heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios winhaj Acab chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tzam yal ko yamanoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Hak'ek owal chi'. Ha Dios Kajal ol ak'anoch t'a yol he k'ab', xchi heb' winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mama wal junok winh schekab' Jehová t'a tik b'aj sko k'anb'ej? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winh: --Ayto wal junxo winh syal slolon yet' Jehová, haton winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla. Palta malaj hin gana swil winh, yujto malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi': --Manh al icha chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtan jun winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ixik t'a elanhchamel, b'at ik'kot winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj rey Acab yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá chi', ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sreyal yuj, ix em k'ojan heb' winh t'a juntzanh xila yik heb' winh rey t'a jun tek'lab' trigo t'a sti'el spuerta'il chonhab' Samaria. Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', ix stz'ak yal heb' winh tas ol aj yak'an ganar heb' winh rey chi'.

Ha winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Quenaana, ix sb'o juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en winh, icha sch'a'ak nok' wakax ix aji, ix yalan winh: Icha wal tik ix aj yalan Jehová: Ha juntzanh yechel ch'a'ak wakax tik, ha sch'oxanel ipalil b'aj ol ak' owal yet' masanil heb' sirio masanto ol satel heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', lajannhej syutej heb' winh yalan t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ixik, ak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot yujto ha Jehová ol ak'anoch t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi heb' winh.

Haxo winh schekab' winh rey ix b'at yik'kot winhaj Micaías chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Masanil heb' winh schekab' Dios wan yalani to wach' ol elk'och winh rey, yuj chi' alpax icha tz'aj yalan heb' winh chi' ha hach tik, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --T'a yichanh Jehová swal t'ayach to ha tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin, ha ol wala', xchi winh.

Ix jawi winhaj Micaías chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik hach Micaías, ¿tom smoj sko yamoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi': --Ixik, ol ak' ganar jun owal chi', yujto ha Jehová ol ak'anoch jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yal winh icha chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Tzijtum elxo swal t'ayach to ha tas yel, ha chi' tzal t'ayin t'a sb'i Jehová, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Ix wila', masanil heb' soldado ketisraelal sakleminak sb'atkan heb' t'a jolomtak witz icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal. Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha juntzanh heb' soldado tik, malaj yilumal heb', meltzajokab' junjun heb' t'a spat t'a junk'olal, xchi, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ina ton swal t'ayach to ha jun winh tik malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, anhej chukal syal winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ab' wal slolonel Jehová. Ix wila' to k'ojanem Jehová t'a yol sdespacho, haxo heb' yángel t'a satcha'anh oyanoch heb' t'a spatik yichanh.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: ¿Mach wal junok hex b'at he montejb'at winhaj Acab yik sb'at winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, yik hata' schamkan winh? xchi. Ch'okch'ok ix yutej heb' ángel chi' yalan t'ay.
Haxo ix aji, ay jun espíritu ix k'och t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yalan icha tik: Ol b'at hin montejb'at winh, xchi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ay: ¿Tas ol utej b'at ha montanb'at winh jun? xchi.

Ix yalan jun espíritu chi' icha tik: Ol hin b'at wek sna' juntzanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi' yik anhej esal lolonel ol yal heb' winh, xchi. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ixik ol yal uj icha tzal chi', xchi.

Yuj chi', ha tikne'ik ha Jehová ix ak'anoch jun espíritu t'a heb' winh ha chekab' tik yik anhej esal lolonel syal heb' winh t'ayach. Ha Jehová ix halani to icha chi' tz'aj ha chami, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

T'a wal jun rato chi' ix snitzankot sb'a winhaj Sedequías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Micaías chi', ix stz'itanb'at sat winhaj Micaías chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun espíritu tz'esan ix kot t'a Jehová chi', ¿tas ix aj yel t'ayin, haxo t'ayach sloloni? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Olxo ab'i ayik ol hach ek' ha k'ub'ejel ha b'a t'a yoltak pat, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi': --Yamec winhaj Micaías tik, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Amón sgobernadoral chonhab' tik yet' t'a winh wuninal aj Joás.

Tzeyalan t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha winh rey ix halani to tz'och jun winh tik t'a preso. Jab'nhej swa'el winh tzeyak'a', jab'nhej pax ha' tzeyak' yuk'ej winh, masanto tzin meltzaj t'a junk'olal, xchi winh rey chi', xe chi t'a heb' winh.

Ix yalan jay b'elanh lolonel tik winhaj Micaías chi': Tato tzach meltzaj t'a junk'olal, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel chi', xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima chi': --Hex wetchonhab', scham wal he na'an jun ix wal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi' yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá. Ix k'och heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha hin tik, ol hin k'exel hin pichul yik ol wak' owal chi', ha hachxo tik, ayokab'nhej och ha pichul yik reyal tik, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix sk'exanel spichul winh chi', ix och winh t'a skal owal chi'.
Haxo pax winh sreyal Siria, toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' 32 yajalil soldado yik carruaje: Manh heyak' owal yet' junokxo mach, palta anhej yet' winh sreyal Israel tzeyak' owal chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix iljib'at winhaj Josafat yuj heb' yajalil soldado chi', ha sna'an heb' to ha winh sreyal Israel, ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' ix el yaw winh.
Ix yab'an heb' soldado chi' to manhoklaj winh sreyal Israel chi', yuj chi' ix yaktej heb' spechan winh.

Palta ay jun soldado sirio ix komon julanb'at sjul-lab' t'a skal heb' soldado wan yak'an owal chi'. k'okb'il wal ha winhaj rey Acab chi' ix yamchaji. Ha wal b'aj schalaj sb'a cha makan k'e'en pichul ayoch yuj winh, hata' ix och jun jul-lab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yamjinak sch'anhal nok' chej tok'jinak carruaje b'aj ayk'e winh chi': --Ik' meltzaj nok' chej tik, tzin ik'anel t'a skal owal tik, yujto te niwan ix hin aj hin lajwi, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' te niwan jun owal ix yak' chi'. Ixto syamk'e linhan winhaj Acab chi' heb' t'a yol carruaje yik tzato wal yak' yip heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' aj Siria chi', ix k'e wal sib'an schik'il winh t'a yol carruaje chi', haxo yik ix em k'u ix cham winh.
Haxo yik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix och jun aw t'a skal masanil heb' soldado, ix yalani: Paxanhek t'a he chonhab', ma t'a he lu'um junjun hex, xchi.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Acab chi', ix ik'jikot sniwanil winh t'a Samaria. Ha t'a Samaria chi' ix mukji winh.

Ix b'ikji'el scarruaje winh chi' t'a jun tanque b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi', b'aj sb'ikel sb'a heb' ix aj mul ix. Hata' ix lek'ji schik'il winhaj Acab chi' yuj nok' tz'i'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jehová.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Acab chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' pax yab'ixal spalacio winh ayoch marfil yelwanub'ok yet' niwak chonhab' ix laj sb'o winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Ocozías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik chanhexo ab'il yoch winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá.
Ayxo 35 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 25 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Azuba sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Silhi.

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Asa smam winh. Anhej to maj scheklaj winh ik'jokel masanil yet'tal b'aj tz'och ejmelal b'aj syak' silab' heb' anima yet' b'aj snhus incienso heb' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh.
Ix och winh t'a junk'olal yet' winh sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winh yet' sb'inajnakil winh yet' b'ajtak ix yak' ganar owal winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Masanil juntzanh winak smulan yet' yetwinakil, ix laj spechel heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en, haton juntzanh heb' winh ixto kan t'a stiempo'al winhaj Asa smam winh.
(Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj rey ayoch t'a Edom, anhej jun winh yajal ak'b'iloch yuj winhaj Josafat.)

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', ix yak' b'ojok juntzanh te' barco winh icha te' yik heb' aj Tarsis, yik sb'at te' yik' k'e'en oro t'a Ofir, palta maj yal-laj sb'at te', yujto ix pojkanb'at te' t'a Ezión-geber.
Ha winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab, ix snib'ej winh ix b'at heb' smunlajwum t'a te' barco yet' heb' yik winhaj Josafat chi', palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winhaj Josafat chi'.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Josafat chi', ix mukji sniwanil winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Joram yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 17 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel t'a chonhab' Samaria. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.

Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha sb'eyb'al smam snun winh ix sb'eyb'alej yet' pax sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal.
Ix och winhaj Ocozías chi' ejmelal t'a komon Dios Baal, icha sk'ulejnak winh smam winh. Icha chi' ix aj stzuntzankot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová sDiosal Israel winh t'a yib'anh.
